query: How do review themes differ between positive and negative IMDb sentiment?

per_column.name: aspect_acting
per_column.rationale: Interpretable count of acting-related mentions; can be segmented (present/absent, low/high) and compared across sentiment to reveal theme differences.

per_column.name: aspect_plot
per_column.rationale: Plot-mention intensity is a meaningful, groupable aspect variable directly relevant to comparing themes by sentiment.

per_column.name: aspect_direction
per_column.rationale: Direction-mention counts are interpretable and support aspect-vs-sentiment comparison.

per_column.name: aspect_music
per_column.rationale: Interpretable though sparse (mostly 0); presence/absence segmentation still informative for theme contrast.

per_column.name: aspect_humor
per_column.rationale: Humor mentions form an interpretable aspect segment usable against sentiment.

per_column.name: aspect_emotion
per_column.rationale: Emotion aspect, though skewed toward 0, gives an interpretable presence/absence grouping.

per_column.name: aspect_special_effects
per_column.rationale: Very sparse (93% zero) but still an interpretable binary-ish aspect signal for theme comparison.

per_column.name: aspect_nostalgia
per_column.rationale: Nostalgia mentions form a clean, interpretable theme segment.

per_column.name: dominant_theme
per_column.rationale: Categorical dominant theme with well-separated, human-readable classes; ideal for cross-tabulation against sentiment. Strongest EDA column.

per_column.name: positive_word_count
per_column.rationale: Interpretable count that can be grouped and compared against sentiment, though partly restates polarity.

per_column.name: negative_word_count
per_column.rationale: Interpretable count usable for segmentation; some overlap with the label itself.

per_column.name: sentiment_word_ratio
per_column.rationale: Essentially a proxy for sentiment polarity; restates the focus rather than opening an external relationship.

per_column.name: sarcasm_signal
per_column.rationale: Near-constant (248/250 are 0); no meaningful comparison can be drawn.

per_column.name: review_length_words
per_column.rationale: External stylistic variable that can be binned and compared against sentiment; interpretable though fine-grained.

judge.rationale: The set is strongly aligned with the EDA intent: it decomposes 'review themes' into interpretable, groupable aspect variables plus a well-separated categorical dominant_theme, which is exactly the segmentation needed to compare themes across positive/negative sentiment. Several aspect columns are sparse (music, emotion, special_effects, nostalgia) limiting comparison power, and a few columns weaken the set: sentiment_word_ratio and the pos/neg word counts partly restate the sentiment focus, and sarcasm_signal is near-constant and non-informative. Overall it enables meaningful relationship discovery, but with redundancy and sparsity dragging the informativeness below excellent.
